title: Clinical Protocol SeCore, uTYPE and 3500 Dx System
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the Invitrogen SeCore(R) sequencing system and uTYPE(R) interpretation software to the predicate device Invitrogen SSP UniTray(R) with UniMatch(R) interpretation software and show 95% concordance with 90% confidence.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Deidentified leftover blood samples
study_population: A, B, C, DRB1, DRB3/4/5, DQB1, DPB1 loci
